data: Is the accuracy range the same for all graphs?

The caption states that the NLI accuracy for the ESIM and decomposable attention (DA) models is shown in figures (a-e). The caption also mentions that the reading comprehension F1 scores for the BiDAF and QANet models are shown in figure (f). 

Looking at the graphs, the y-axis represents accuracy or F1 scores, which are percentages. The x-axis represents the number of fine-tuning examples. The graphs show different ranges of accuracy values for different challenges. For example, the range of accuracy values for the NLI tasks (a-e) is approximately 55% to 80%, while the range of F1 scores for the reading comprehension task (f) is approximately 45% to 85%. Therefore, the accuracy range is not the same for all graphs.
